title: Salvage Title Transfer & Customer Buyout Rights
citation: Illustrative Motor Comprehensive Policy — Section 4 (Loss Settlement), Clause 4.4
text: Upon total loss classification, full vehicle salvage ownership transfers to the Insurer. If the policyholder requests to retain the damaged vehicle salvage (subject to insurer consent and non-structural scrap classification), the certified residual salvage valuation shall be deducted from the gross settlement sum payable to the insured.
